title: 3D-ish parallax depth
prompt: A 3D-feeling parallax shot: a stylised mountain landscape in 5 depth layers (sky gradient, far mountains, mid hills, near trees, foreground grass) with a slow camera push and pan to the right. Farther layers move less and scale less than near ones; add atmospheric haze (lighter, lower-contrast far layers). A title "Into the Quiet" fades in mid-shot at a depth between the hills and trees.

checklist.text: parallax: ≥3 layers moving at clearly different speeds
gradient sky or haze (gradient paint or translucent layers)
title sits between hills and trees in the layer order
